test_title: PYST 25: SSC CGL 2022 - English (Held On: 08 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

She became frustrated with her poor health and began to lose ________ of her recovery
solution:
The correct answer is** hope.**** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• The complete sentence will be, **She became frustrated with her poor health and began to lose *hope* of her recovery. **
 
• “**Hope”** is the right fit as it completes the meaning of the sentence.
 
• Using other words like “**weight”, “money”, “idea” ** would render the sentence meaningless.
